description: Pass rules of the external-review adoption program: result B of compare (the frozen candidate F) against result A (the baseline B0), on each split (dev, test) the results record (testset.split; a result without one is all dev). docs/BENCHMARK.md section 6.2.
decisions: Owner question 1, answered by default (the owner may override): supported coverage is primary in the building-local frame (Sim3 to the reference) at 1.5 m; geographic at 5 m is secondary; geographic at 1.5 m is information only.
Evaluation design question 7, by default: a single building's guard regression blocks a candidate; a single building's coverage regression does not (the primary is pooled).
Cost is CPU time (user + system), not wall time, because runs may share the machine's cores; request latency and time to pose are what a contributor waits for.
